Name: Cow Eggs and Chicken Milk
Author: LinSterling
Description:
[b][color=#6d9eeb][size=4]Description[/size][/color][/b]
Adds new cursed produce: small and large cow eggs, small and large chicken milk, chicken cheese and cow mayonnaise.
It's a bit of a shitpost that came to me in the early morning hours as I was lying in a haze fighting medication side effects and pondering my life choices. I'm not sorry though.

All items have normal context tags (egg_item, milk_item, etc.), so they work in cooking recipes that accept standard eggs, milk, cheese or mayonnaise.

Includes saturation toggle and sprites style options! Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to config to your liking. Defaults are Saturated + Vanilla.
Sprites styles:
  ✨ Vanilla
  ✨ Vanilla Tweaks
  ✨ Milk Bottles and Cans
Configs are separate for eggs, milk, cheese and mayo, so you can mix and match (for example, turn on vanilla cheese and mayo sprites and Milk Bottles and Cans milk sprites).

Note: this is my first custom produce mod so I'm not 100% sure I've done everything right. Please, report any issues and I will fix them

[b][color=#6d9eeb][size=4]Requirements[/size][/color][/b]
  1. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url]
  2. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
  3. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328]Extra Animal Configs (EAC)[/url]
  4. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]

[b][color=#6d9eeb][size=4]Installation[/size][/color][/b]
  1. Download
  2. Unzip
  3. Plonk "Cow Eggs and Chicken Milk" into Stardew Valley\Mods
  4. Should work unless I borked something (in that case, let me know)
  5. Uhh... enjoy?
  6. Maybe endorse this mod if you liked it? :3 i.e. if you're a maniac like me

[b][color=#6d9eeb][size=4]Future updates[/size][/color][/b]
  📖 use daily luck to decide if the animals drop cursed items
  📖 maybe sprite tweaks if I suddenly decide they look bad
  📖 more sprites options (cometkins and some others probably) (alternatively, if someone else wants to make a retexture and beats me to it - I absolutely don't mind)
  📖 split produce into white and brown versions if I let intrusive thoughts win
  📖 optional large mayonnaise and large cheese
  📖 more crimes: duck milk and goat eggs (dear god)
  📖 possibly even more crimes: some cursed recipes like chicken milkshake or something
